observations.body: Solomon sits on David’s throne while the narrative describes the kingdom becoming firmly established.
observations.label: Solomon’s kingdom is established

observations.body: The passage places God’s Kingdom beside solomon’s kingdom is established.

payload.posture: Read 1 Kings 2:10–17 as evidence about the Kingdom, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: The passage states solomon sits on David’s throne while the narrative describes the kingdom becoming firmly established. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Kingdom.
payload.title: Solomon’s kingdom is established
